name: Septate Vagina

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Septate Vagina

criteria.description: Presence of a longitudinal vaginal septum detected on physical examination
Confirmation of vaginal septum by pelvic MRI or ultrasound
Symptoms such as dyspareunia, obstructed menstruation, or difficulty with tampon insertion

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a longitudinal vaginal septum confirmed by clinical examination and imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be incidental during gynecological examination or investigation of reproductive issues

pathognomonic.symptomName: Longitudinal vaginal septum detected on examination
searchTerms: long vertical vaginal wall dividing canal
discomfort during sex due to vaginal wall
blocked menstrual flow or blood buildup in vagina
obstructed period causing vaginal blood collection
pain in lower abdomen or pelvis

occasional.symptomName: Urinary tract symptoms due to adjacent organ compression
searchTerms: urinary symptoms from pressure by nearby organs
bladder problems due to organ compression

occasional.symptomName: Psychological distress related to sexual dysfunction
searchTerms: psychological issues related to sexual dysfunction
mental health impact of sexual difficulties
blood collection forming in vaginal tissue

rare.symptomName: Secondary endometriosis due to obstructed menstruation
searchTerms: uterine tissue growth from menstrual obstruction

imaging: Pelvic MRI showing longitudinal vaginal septum
Ultrasound demonstrating vaginal septation and possible hematocolpos
other: Physical examination revealing a longitudinal vaginal septum dividing the vaginal canal

distinguishingFeatures: Transverse rather than longitudinal vaginal septum
Complete absence or closure of vaginal canal
No vaginal lumen present on examination

redFlags: Severe obstructive symptoms causing hematocolpos or hematometra
Recurrent pelvic infections or abscess formation
references: American Society for Reproductive Medicine. Uterine Anomalies: Diagnosis and Management. Fertil Steril. 2020.
Rock JA, Zacur HA. Surgery for vaginal anomalies. Obstet Gynecol Clin North Am. 1993.
